" In the future, this method could allow engineers to prototype faster, explore a wider range of chip designs, and discover new design schemes that might improve the performance and energy efficiency of robots, medical monitors, or industrial sensors. The MIT method, called Small LM Iterating on Circuits, or SLIC (pronounced “slick”), enables engineers to train a small language model to perform analog circuit design as well as or better than a frontier large language model (LLM). This small model is inexpensive and efficient enough to run on a laptop.
